input.title: Ignore RUSTSEC-2026-0459 (libsqlite3-sys 0.37) until sqlx allows libsqlite3-sys >= 0.39
input.description:
## What happened

On 2026-11-12, the `audit` and `deny` gates on `main` failed. The cause is a new advisory, RUSTSEC-2026-0459. It flags `libsqlite3-sys` 0.37.0, which bundles C SQLite with CVE-2026-119375 (severity 6.8, medium). The fix is `libsqlite3-sys` 0.39.0 or later.

The failure is not from a code change. PR #331 (async-openai bump) was the first push to `main` after the advisory was published.

## Why a lockfile update cannot fix it

`sqlx-sqlite` 0.9.0 requires `libsqlite3-sys = ">=0.30.1, <0.38.0"`. `sqlx` 0.9.0 is the latest release. Thus no compatible fixed version exists.

Path: `libsqlite3-sys` → `sqlx-sqlite` → `sqlx` → `paigasus-helikon-evals`, `paigasus-helikon-sessions-sqlite`, `paigasus-helikon-sessions-postgres`.

## Decision

Sven decided on 2026-11-12: add RUSTSEC-2026-0459 to the ignore lists in `.cargo/audit.toml` and `deny.toml`. This unblocks all PRs. This ticket tracks the removal of the ignore.

## To do

- [x] Add the ignore to `.cargo/audit.toml` and `deny.toml`.
- [ ] When a `sqlx` release allows `libsqlite3-sys` >= 0.39, bump `sqlx` and remove both ignore entries.
- [ ] Make sure that `cargo audit --deny warnings` and `cargo deny check advisories` pass without the ignore.

## Note

The vulnerable SQLite code ships in the published crates that use `sqlx` with SQLite. Users who need the fix before the `sqlx` release can use the `sqlx` unbundled SQLite feature with a fixed system SQLite.

I did not merge PR #334, because its first CI run was red. I added a second fix, and CI now runs again on the new head commit `69da9886`.

**What failed:** On the ubuntu and macOS stable legs, `trybuild_ui` failed in `paigasus-helikon-core` (5 of 8 snapshots). This is not caused by the advisory ignore. GitHub runners now use rustc 1.100.0 (released 2026-11-09), and it draws the E0599 diagnostics without the multi-line span guide. This failure will also occur on `main` and on every PR. It is the same problem as SMA-386.

**What I did:**
- I made SMA-764 for this failure.
- I re-blessed the five `.stderr` snapshots with `TRYBUILD=overwrite cargo +1.100.0 test -p paigasus-helikon-core --test trybuild_ui`. The test then passed locally without overwrite. The diff removes only the span drawing. The error codes, messages and notes do not change.
- I added the change to PR #334 as the commit `test(core): SMA-764 …`. The two fixes must be in one PR because each one needs the other to get a green CI.
- Windows still uses rustc 1.99.1, but it skips `trybuild_ui`, so this change does not affect it.
- I installed the `1.100.0` toolchain locally. Your default `stable` toolchain is still 1.99.0.

**Side effect:** The snapshot files are in the packaged `core` crate. Thus release-plz will probably make a patch bump for `core` and cascade it to the dependent crates. SMA-386 had the same effect.

When the checks finish, I will verify all 15 required checks on `69da9886`. If they are green, I will merge, move SMA-763 back to Backlog, and check release PR #333.
